chapter.title: Kumite: Break the Bracket
chapter.subtitle: Eight contenders. One ambushed bracket. Find the Glo.
chapter.description: When Sho’Nuff and a two-on-one ambush break the tournament order, Leroy, Bushedo Brown, and Undercova Brotha fight through eight anime episodes to take back the arena.

tips: Eight contenders enter beneath the bracket board: four quarterfinals, two semifinals, and one final.
Watch or skip any episode film at any time; replay remains available on the node.

scenes.speaker: Chonk Lee
scenes.text: Eight names on the board. Red lights up top, yellow flags on the wall, and no referees saving you when the bell rings.

scenes.speaker: Bushedo Brown
scenes.text: Respect the bracket, read the three districts, and keep your hands up. Every fighter in this hallway earned their invitation.

scenes.speaker: Leroy
scenes.text: I did not come here to talk about titles. Show me the first table.

nodes.title: Tale of the Tape Reach Matrix

tips: Sort four scouting comparisons: reach gap, belt range, mirror guard, then gold/red. These cards are not the live bracket draw.

scenes.speaker: Undercova Brotha
scenes.text: Scouting cards, not the live draw. Compare the styles before you commit your crew.

scenes.speaker: Bushedo Brown
scenes.text: Start with the reach gap. Finish with the gold-and-red contrast.

puzzle.title: Tale of the Tape Reach Matrix
puzzle.instruction: Sort four scouting comparisons: reach gap, belt range, mirror guard, then gold/red. These cards are not the live bracket draw.

pieces.label: Scouting Pair A
pieces.detail: Chonk Lee / Dragonfly Jones · widest reach gap

pieces.label: Scouting Pair B
pieces.detail: Franklin Duke / P. Tang · power against belt range

hints: Read the tape: widest gap, belt range, orthodox mirror, gold/red.
puzzle.solvedText: Technique logged. The next bout is ready.
puzzle.skipText: Training skipped. You can return to this manual.

tips: P. Tang punishes crowded lanes with knockback; spread your Hands across two districts.
Round 1 adds a temporary Dragonfly Jones to your hand for this fight.

passive.name: Belt Check
passive.description: Round 1 adds a temporary Dragonfly Jones to your hand. Hold two districts against P. Tang's belt pressure.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Dragonfly Jones
preDialogue.text: Quiet in the stands! Seven-time grandmaster stepping onto the mat—watch the footwork!

preDialogue.speaker: P. Tang
preDialogue.text: Boy, my belt has more reach than your whole speech. Step into the middle lane and find out.

postDialogue.speaker: Dragonfly Jones
postDialogue.text: Alright, the belt caught my jacket—not my pride. Next round is yours.

postDialogue.speaker: P. Tang
postDialogue.text: Good balance. Keep moving like that when the heavy hitters step up.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: Arrange the five fictional strike cues to open the guard.

scenes.speaker: P. Tang
scenes.text: This stunt manual's got five cues. Put the combination back together before you try to improvise.

scenes.speaker: Dragonfly Jones
scenes.text: I improvise professionally. The floor keeps changing my choreography.

puzzle.title: Dim Mak Meridian Map
puzzle.instruction: Arrange the five fictional strike cues to open the guard.

pieces.label: Liver Hook
pieces.detail: Turn the torso toward the open lane.

pieces.label: Floating Rib
pieces.detail: Draw the elbow away from the body.

hints: Arm opens; elbow lifts; body turns; center breaks; gate opens.
puzzle.solvedText: Technique logged. The next bout is ready.
puzzle.skipText: Training skipped. You can return to this manual.

tips: Franklin Duke pressures the center; claim the outside districts before round three locks the middle.
Round 1 adds a temporary Leroy to your hand so you can time the counter.

passive.name: First Gold Spark
passive.description: The center district locks in round three. Round 1 adds a temporary Leroy to your hand.

preDialogue.speaker: Franklin Duke
preDialogue.text: They told me Leroy had a secret glow. All I see is somebody backing toward the ropes.

preDialogue.speaker: Leroy
preDialogue.text: Breathe first. Read the rib shot, then answer cleanly on the outside.

postDialogue.speaker: Franklin Duke
postDialogue.text: Wait—my hands shook on that counter. What was that gold spark?

postDialogue.speaker: Bushedo Brown
postDialogue.text: Just the first spark. He hasn't even opened the door yet.

tips: Connect the fictional Glo chain from floor to finishing uppercut.

scenes.speaker: Leroy
scenes.text: Feet, hips, breath, focus. Carry one clean motion all the way through.

scenes.speaker: Bushedo Brown
scenes.text: The first spark starts with control. Read the seven cues from the floor up.

puzzle.title: 7-Chakra · Find the Glo
puzzle.instruction: Connect the fictional Glo chain from floor to finishing uppercut.

pieces.label: Glo · Finish
pieces.detail: Carry the chain through the uppercut.

hints: Feet, hips, core, pulse, breath, read, Glo. The top seal is a fist.
puzzle.solvedText: Technique logged. The next bout is ready.
puzzle.skipText: Training skipped. You can return to this manual.

tips: Bushedo Brown and Undercova trade disruption and district control; keep 1 Motion in reserve.
Round 1 adds Undercova Brotha to your hand as temporary backup.

passive.name: 88 Seconds of Technique
passive.description: Round 1 adds Undercova Brotha to your hand. At round four, Bushedo Brown gains +1 Motion.

phases.name: Second Stance
phases.description: At round four, Bushedo Brown gains 1 extra Motion.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Undercova Brotha
preDialogue.text: Phone checked. Watch calibrated. Let's keep this professional, Bushedo.

preDialogue.speaker: Bushedo Brown
preDialogue.text: Professional courtesy means I don't hold back a single hand. Show me your form.

postDialogue.speaker: Bushedo Brown
postDialogue.text: Clean exchange. Neither of us gave an inch for eighty-eight seconds.

postDialogue.speaker: Undercova Brotha
postDialogue.text: Hold up—look at the bracket board. Somebody just crossed out the semifinal order.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: Read the five feints in order: high straight, reach, chest drive, short hook, low rush.

scenes.speaker: Undercova Brotha
scenes.text: Five feints. I'll tell you what I show; you tell me which form answers.

scenes.speaker: Bushedo Brown
scenes.text: Read the opening, then choose the counter. Every answer is in the manual.

puzzle.title: 5-Form Kung Fu Manual
puzzle.instruction: Read the five feints in order: high straight, reach, chest drive, short hook, low rush.
hints: Each form’s counter names the opening it answers.
puzzle.solvedText: Technique logged. The next bout is ready.
puzzle.skipText: Training skipped. You can return to this manual.

tips: Alternate hands through upper, middle, lower, upper, middle, sweep.

scenes.speaker: Bushedo Brown
scenes.text: Upper, middle, lower. Change the lead hand every beat.

scenes.speaker: Dragonfly Jones
scenes.text: Left, right, left, right. I've mastered the counting. Now for the landing.

puzzle.title: Shaolin Wooden Dummy
puzzle.instruction: Alternate hands through upper, middle, lower, upper, middle, sweep.

pieces.label: Left · Lower Gate
pieces.detail: Lead left under the lower arm.

pieces.label: Right · Upper Return
pieces.detail: Lead right at the upper arm.

pieces.label: Right · Sweep Peg
pieces.detail: Lead right past the sweep peg.

pieces.label: Left · Upper Gate
pieces.detail: Lead left at the upper arm.

hints: No repeated lead hand: L R L R L R.

tips: A knockdown on the mat does not prove elimination when outside interference hits the floor.

scenes.speaker: Undercova Brotha
scenes.text: The announcer is calling a foul on the mic—two-on-one in the corridor and the officials aren't stepping in.

scenes.speaker: Bushedo Brown
scenes.text: They aren't trying to win the bracket. They're trying to break it so Sho'Nuff takes the arena by force.

scenes.speaker: Leroy
scenes.text: Nobody hijacks this floor while we're standing on it. Clear the aisle.

tips: Subtract each logged offset and restore the bout chronology.

scenes.speaker: Undercova Brotha
scenes.text: Somebody shifted the ringside clocks. I kept the slips, including every offset.

scenes.speaker: Leroy
scenes.text: Put the bell and the ambush back in order. Let the record speak.

puzzle.title: Broken Bracket Timecode
puzzle.instruction: Subtract each logged offset and restore the bout chronology.
hints: Negative offsets mean the rigged clock was behind.
puzzle.solvedText: Technique logged. The next bout is ready.

tips: Sho'Nuff brings heavy lane pressure; use your round-1 Bushedo Brown and round-2 Leroy reinforcements to hold two districts.

passive.name: Shogun Interruption
passive.description: Round 1 adds Bushedo Brown and Round 2 adds Leroy to your hand. At round four, Sho'Nuff surges with +1 Motion.

phases.name: Shogun Ambush
phases.description: At round four, Sho'Nuff gains 1 Motion.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Sho'Nuff
preDialogue.text: Forget the scoreboard! Who's the master?! This whole arena belongs to the Shogun now!

preDialogue.speaker: Leroy
preDialogue.text: You jumped the corridor and hijacked the bracket. Step into the center and answer to both of us.

postDialogue.speaker: Sho'Nuff
postDialogue.text: You think one round stops the Shogun?! Turn the red lights up—ask me again who the master is!

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: Calibrate the game’s five-link strike chain from floor to fist.

scenes.speaker: Bushedo Brown
scenes.text: The stunt diagram shows five connected cues. Rebuild the chain from floor to fist.

scenes.speaker: Leroy
scenes.text: One clean line. Keep the whole motion together.

puzzle.title: Bone-Impact X-Ray
puzzle.instruction: Calibrate the game’s five-link strike chain from floor to fist.

pieces.label: Metacarpal Alignment
pieces.detail: Finish with a straight fictional impact line.

pieces.label: Hip Turn
pieces.detail: Transfer the push through the pelvis.

scenes.text: The corner crew handles the fighter. You handle the order on this cinema chart.

scenes.speaker: Undercova Brotha
scenes.text: Bell starts the sequence. Clear the stool at the end. Read what comes between.

tips: The two-stage finale: Leroy's gold aura boosts your left and center districts by +2 Hands at the start.
Save 2 Motion at the final bell to earn all three mastery stars.

passive.name: I Got the Glo
passive.description: Leroy's gold awakening grants +2 Hands in the left and center districts and adds Leroy to your opening hand.

phases.name: Red Glow Clash
phases.description: At round four, Sho'Nuff's final surge grants +1 CPU Motion and +2 Hands in the right district.

starObjectives.description: Win at least two districts against Sho'Nuff's takeover.

postDialogue.speaker: Bushedo Brown
postDialogue.text: One gold uppercut and the whole takeover came apart.

postDialogue.speaker: Leroy
postDialogue.text: The bracket is back in order. Every fighter gets a fair count.

starObjectives.description: Win at least two districts against Sho'Nuff's takeover.

tips: Order the five waveform cues. 12:57 marks the Glo moment on the full tournament clock; this chapter has its own timer.

scenes.speaker: Leroy
scenes.text: Hear the rhythm in the full reel. That gold frame is marked twelve fifty-seven.

scenes.speaker: Bushedo Brown
scenes.text: Each chapter starts its own clock. Put the manual's five cues in order.

puzzle.instruction: Order the five waveform cues. 12:57 marks the Glo moment on the full tournament clock; this chapter has its own timer.

pieces.label: Release · Gold Frame
pieces.detail: Land on the gold impact marker.

hints: 4 in, 2 held, 6 out, 1 still, then the gold cue.

scenes.speaker: Bushedo Brown
scenes.text: The lights are back up and the eight-player board is clean. Weekly brackets and the Dojo Boss Raid are open.

scenes.speaker: Undercova Brotha
scenes.text: The films stay here. The unlock road keeps your real progress. Bring ten cards when you're ready for the weekly bracket.

scenes.speaker: Leroy
scenes.text: See you in the Kumite.

tips: Place all five fist seals in the Dojo’s tier order.

scenes.speaker: Bushedo Brown
scenes.text: Five masters, five tiers. Put their fist seals in the Dojo's order.

scenes.speaker: Leroy
scenes.text: Study the archive freely. Defeat each master in a real raid to earn their stamp.
